subject: Exec sponsor orchestration and decision checklist for NOVA Retail Group
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Perez <samantha.perez@novaretail.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-07-11T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Exec sponsor orchestration and decision checklist for NOVA Retail Group

Hi Samantha + team,

Thanks again for taking time today — great to meet the NOVA group. Quick recap from our discovery and a proposed set of next steps so we can get the steering committee scheduled and productive: 

1) Stakeholder mapping (as we understood it)
- Executive sponsor / economic buyer: Samantha Perez (CPO) — final sign-off on roadmap + budget
- Technical buyer / security owner: Manjit Singh (Head of Platform) — security, infra, integration constraints
- Procurement: procurement@novaretail.com — PO, vendor setup, contracts
- Product/Analytics partner: TBD (asked to include brief list of use cases)

2) Decision criteria we heard on the call (please correct):
- Predictable latency and cost per inference at scale
- Data residency / audit logs for PII-sensitive flows
- Clear rollout path (canary -> phased rollouts) with rollback capabilities
- Contract/PO clarity and vendor onboarding timeline

3) Immediate asks / next steps
- Can you confirm the steering committee attendee list and who will represent Legal?
- Procurement timeline: what internal dates/approval gates should we plan to hit?
- Please nominate the security questionnaire owner so we can route the SOC2/infra items.
- Steering committee — propose a 60-minute slot for an exec briefing (30m) + technical deep dive (30m). We can split into two adjacent blocks if that helps scheduling.

Attached: Redwood-Steering-Prep.pdf (prep deck template) and NOVA-SOW-draft-v1.docx (initial SOW stub).

I'll follow up with a few proposed times later today; Ben will add a perf/cost slide and Lauren will send a calendar poll.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this on the calendar.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.ai

---
(attachment stubs: Redwood-Steering-Prep.pdf [15 pages], NOVA-SOW-draft-v1.docx [draft])

From: Samantha Perez <samantha.perez@novaretail.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@novaretail.com>, Manjit Singh <manjit.singh@novaretail.com>
Date: 2027-07-12T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Exec sponsor orchestration and decision checklist for NOVA Retail Group

Thanks Rachel — great summary. Confirming a few items from our side:

- I will be the exec sponsor. I will bring the 1) CIO (executive readout), 2) Head of Data Product (use cases), and 3) VP Engineering (ops).
- Manjit will own the security questionnaire + infra Qs (cc'd). Legal is managed centrally by Procurement for initial vendor setup; they require a completed vendor security questionnaire + proof of SOC2 or equivalent.
- Procurement timeline: internal PO & vendor onboarding target is end of August; procurement needs a high-level commercial summary (T-shirt pricing + preferred contract term) before July 22 to make our August window.

For the steering committee slot, Jul 20 or Jul 22 are both possible; prefer afternoons PT. Please include a short slide (1 slide) that outlines: unit cost estimates at three volume tiers, a short fallback plan if SLA targets drift, and proposed rollout phases.

If you can send the one-slide commercial summary and the steering prep deck by EOD Jul 15, we should be able to secure the PO decision path.

Thanks,
Samantha Perez
Chief Product Officer | NOVA Retail Group
Samantha.Perez@novaretail.com

---
(Procurement note: require vendor questionnaire link and billing contact)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Perez <samantha.perez@novaretail.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-07-12T11:32:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Exec sponsor orchestration and decision checklist for NOVA Retail Group

Samantha — thanks for the clarity. Quick plan from our side to make the steering meeting efficient:

- Proposal: split the 60m into 30m exec briefing (value & economics) + 30m technical deep dive (Manjit + VP Eng). That keeps exec time tight while giving ops the detail they need.
- I'll prepare the one-slide commercial summary with three volume tiers (pilot, regional, national) and attach a short risk/fallback row (model variant fallbacks, burst capacity options).
- For procurement: we can provide a redline-friendly PO exhibit and vendor questionnaire answers within 48 hours of receiving the questionnaire form.
- For rollout: propose an initial canary (1% traffic, two-week observation) -> 10% -> 50% over a month; include rollback thresholds tied to latency & error rates.

Rachel — I can have the commercial slide and a 2-slide ops appendix by EOD Jul 15. What time on Jul 20/22 does the team prefer? Afternoon PT works for us as well.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

(attachment stubs: commercial-summary-onepager.pdf [1 page], rollout-playbook-notes.txt [3 pages])

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Perez <samantha.perez@novaretail.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Procurement <procurement@novaretail.com>, Manjit Singh <manjit.singh@novaretail.com>
Date: 2027-07-13T14:20:00-07:00
Subject: Proposed steering committee slots (NOVA Retail Group)

Hi all — following up with three proposed slots for the 60-minute steering committee (exec briefing + technical dive). Please confirm preferred slot by Jul 15 so we can lock calendars: 

- Option A: Tue Jul 20, 09:00 - 10:00 PT
- Option B: Tue Jul 20, 15:00 - 16:00 PT
- Option C: Thu Jul 22, 10:00 - 11:00 PT

Agenda (30m exec + 30m tech):
- 0:00-0:05 Introductions & desired outcome (Samantha)
- 0:05-0:35 Exec briefing: business value, high-level economics (Ben + Rachel)
- 0:35-1:00 Technical and security deep dive (Manjit + Redwood platform lead)

Action items for Redwood (by Jul 15):
- 1-slide commercial summary (Ben)
- Steering prep deck + SOW stub (Rachel)
- Ops appendix & rollout thresholds (Ben)

If procurement needs a separate call before the steering committee, let us know and we'll add a short slot.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Program Manager, Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.ai

(P.S. calendar poll link: https://calendar.google.com/poll/unique-poll-id )

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samantha Perez <samantha.perez@novaretail.com>, Manjit Singh <manjit.singh@novaretail.com>, Procurement <procurement@novaretail.com>
Date: 2027-07-16T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Exec sponsor orchestration and decision checklist for NOVA Retail Group

Thanks everyone — quick confirmation from Redwood leadership: we will target Option B (Tue Jul 20, 15:00 - 16:00 PT). Rachel, please send the final steering prep deck and the one-slide commercial summary to procurement and the execs by EOD Jul 18 so Procurement has time to review before Jul 22.

Ben — please ensure the slide includes: 
- clear unit economics at pilot / regional / national volumes
- latency SLO targets and fallback model variants
- a short acceptance checklist (what sign-off looks like post-cano y)

Rachel — I'll join the session and can cover the rollout acceptance criteria from an operations perspective. Also flagging that Legal might ask for indemnity language in the SOW; include a placeholder exhibit for that.

If anyone needs to shift due to calendar conflicts, flag by EOD Jul 17.

Karthik Iyer
Head of Sales | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
